fusions.name: First Glance
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt at an enemy that deals 4 arcane damage. Against an enemy that has not been wounded yet, it has 50% more critical hit chance.

fusions.name: All-Round Watch
fusions.desc: Sends out a burst that deals 28 arcane damage to every enemy within 4 tiles of you, on every side. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: See It Coming
fusions.desc: Raises your dodge chance by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Broad Daylight
fusions.desc: In daylight, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
